description: This file defines an abstract class VarianceBase within the PhpSpreadsheet library, containing utility methods for data type adjustments used in statistical variance calculations.

classes.name: VarianceBase
classes.description: An abstract class providing base methods for variance calculations, including data type adjustments.

methods.name: datatypeAdjustmentAllowStrings
methods.description: Adjusts the input value for variance calculations, converting booleans to integers and strings to zero.

methods.name: datatypeAdjustmentBooleans
methods.description: Converts boolean values to integers if in OpenOffice compatibility mode; otherwise, returns the value unchanged.
